name: Local Models
description: Choose local models for images, textures, sound, music and 3D. Qwen Turbo Q4/Q8, Stable Audio and Hunyuan3D Turbo/Mini. Experimental platform profiles; 3D needs separate Windows CUDA setup. Each native job is capped at five minutes. New Q8/Mini inference is not yet verified.

tools.name: inspect-use
tools.description: Required after integrating a generated asset. Observe the current game through the same host service as Genex Tools. Reports missing runtime loads, captures the actual frame, and verifies audible playback. A delivered file or loader stub is not integration.

tools.name: verify-use
tools.description: Record visible asset use after a successful current inspect-use. Use its exact inspectionId and describe what is visible in the attached frame. Cannot verify missing runtime loads.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Inspect assigned local generation models and readiness. No weights are loaded. Use before creating an asset.

tools.name: generate-image
tools.description: Generate a local PNG. Default assets, icons and model-reference purposes automatically receive Qwen native RGBA instructions and must pass a real alpha check. Agent supplies only its object description. Use purpose:scene for a full illustration or task:texture for an opaque material. One bounded native retry on alpha failure; no image editing or paid fallback.

purpose.description: Default asset: native transparent PNG. icon: readable icon. model-reference: isolated three-quarter object. scene: full image with a background. Do not set purpose for task:texture.

tools.name: generate-audio
tools.description: Generate sound effects or music with the assigned installed Stable Audio 3 Small Q8 model. One worker, unloaded after completion. No paid fallback.

tools.name: generate-model
tools.description: Generate Hunyuan3D in separate five-minute jobs. Exactly one input: prompt saves a reference; imageJobId or image saves an untextured shape; shapeJobId paints that retained shape. Immediately follow nextCall between stages. A paint failure returns paint-incomplete with retained shapeAssets, never a finished textured model. Reuse job IDs; never retry failed work automatically. Windows x64 NVIDIA CUDA; RTX 4070 12 GB / 32 GB RAM tested; slower hardware may time out.

quality.description: Default balanced: 384 shape, 50k triangles, native 512px paint views, 1K atlas. Experimental high: 512 shape, up to 200k triangles, 512px views, 2K atlas; may introduce texture noise and takes longer. Both preserve surface normals. Higher density does not guarantee better appearance; inspect the result. No silent downgrade.

prompt.description: Describe the object and art style. Returns a reference-ready continuation, then shape-ready, then the textured GLB. Follow each nextCall in a separate call.

imageJobId.description: Exact completed image job UUID from this game; no manual copy or new image generation.

image.description: Exact project-relative PNG/JPEG/WebP path under assets/ or public/.

shapeJobId.description: Exact completed model-shape job UUID from this project. Reuses its mesh, prepared PNG, seed and quality without regenerating the reference or shape.

tools.name: retrieve
tools.description: Restore a retained job into the current game/build through normal Genex Assets delivery. Reuses saved bytes, never regenerates; refuses to overwrite changed files. Only jobs belonging to this game.

tools.name: assets
tools.description: List this game's retained Local Models assets and exact job IDs, including results from stopped builds. Read only: no models run and no files are copied. Use retrieve to restore a result into the current workspace.

skills.name: local-assets
skills.text:
For a requested game build or art pass, read theastraydev-local-models__skill {"name":"game-quality"}, {"name":"genex"} and {"name":"asset-preference"} once. Deliver a polished playable result while preserving the person's style and scope. Planning-only, status and narrow repair requests do not authorize unrelated generation.

The lead owns completion. Before delegation, turn requested asset categories into acceptance entries: asset/role, required or optional, generation owner, integration owner, retained job ID, exact delivered URL, and integration/verification state. Read the asset-preference build-orchestration reference before coordinating a build. Check theastraydev-local-models__status and theastraydev-local-models__assets for this project. Start one local asset owner alongside foundation work as soon as the host permits; do not wait for foundation polish. If the host cannot overlap them, start the reusable hero/reference work first or schedule the asset owner at the first permitted opportunity, and report the actual constraint.

Only one owner runs GPU generation sequentially. After a final game asset completes, hand its exact job ID/URL to its named integration owner and connect it to the playable scene before generating an unplanned variation. References are intermediate inputs to the mesh, not finished game assets. Prompt-to-3D returns completed:false and nextCall; immediately follow each continuation with the retained imageJobId, then shapeJobId. Shape and paint are separate five-minute jobs. If paint returns paint-incomplete, keep the untextured shapeAssets and clearly report unfinished texturing; do not regenerate or retry automatically. A restart, failed camera check or new worktree is not a reason to regenerate: list this project's jobs and use theastraydev-local-models__retrieve, which preserves changed files. Transfer completed IDs, integration changes and the remaining observed defect across owner changes.

Before accepting a generated-asset milestone or reporting the whole build complete, inspect the current integrated game: real entity loads the returned GLB/image URL, requested sound/music plays after a user gesture, and placeholders for required content are gone. Use theastraydev-local-models__inspect-use then theastraydev-local-models__verify-use only with successful current evidence. Unsupported observation stays unverified; do not fabricate a pass. Keep working on required integration or name the blocker. Separate worker screenshots and generated-file receipts do not prove the integrated game. A shared camera/boot defect should be repaired once at its owner while retaining valid generated bytes; do not repeatedly discard asset work or weaken checks.

Maximize useful finish, not call count. Generate the content categories relevant to the brief, including environment/secondary assets and music when requested; respect procedural-only, no-audio, existing-library and provider choices. Studio writes VFX, shaders and game logic, and reviews them in motion; the installed asset models do not generate shader code. Use the exact returned assets[].url: nested deliveries need a suitable loader, not the template's root-slug loadAsset(name). Qwen requests native RGBA for isolated assets, icons and model references; use task:texture for opaque tiles and purpose:scene for backgrounds. Hunyuan is image-conditioned; balanced is tested, high is an opt-in density experiment that can worsen paint. Reuse usable results; regenerate only for a named visible defect with a concrete change. No silent paid fallback, downloads, model reassignment, app patching or publishing.

skills.name: asset-preference
skills.summary: Choose and integrate local generated assets during a requested game build, without needing a separate request for each model.

skills.name: cover
skills.summary: Choose a real gameplay cover for a game built with local assets, separately from generated UI art and the Studio sidebar image.

skills.name: creator-mcp
skills.summary: Coordinate Local Models with the bundled Genex creator MCP without confusing local generation, remote discovery and publishing.

skills.name: game-quality
skills.summary: Turn a Genex game brief into a distinctive, polished playable result; direct local asset models, 3D, VFX and shaders, then review actual gameplay before claiming quality.

skills.name: genex
skills.summary: Build a playable Genex game using local image, audio and mesh models automatically, from the brief through asset integration and verification.

skills.name: genex-cover
skills.summary: Stage and capture an honest 16 by 9 gameplay frame using Genex cover tools after integrating local assets.

skills.name: genex-llm-in-games
skills.summary: Route explicitly requested runtime NPC and quest inference through Genex's supported player approval flow instead of desktop asset generators.

skills.name: genex-monetization
skills.summary: Use locally generated item art alongside Genex's optional shop and purchase flow without treating the local plugin as a payment backend.

skills.name: genex-threejs-embed-auth
skills.summary: Keep player identity, saves and leaderboards on Genex when a locally generated game needs platform features.

skills.name: genex-threejs-multiplayer
skills.summary: Add optional Genex multiplayer while keeping locally generated meshes and sounds as static game assets.

skills.name: genex-tool-llm
skills.summary: Distinguish models used to build assets from an LLM requested inside the finished game, such as NPC dialogue or dynamic quests.

skills.name: genex-tool-publish
skills.summary: Check that local model outputs ship in a static export before using the official Genex draft or gallery publishing tools.

skills.name: genex-updates
skills.summary: Handle plugin, runtime and Genex compatibility updates without changing the user's game, assignments or installed model weights unnecessarily.

skills.name: publishing
skills.summary: Publish a locally generated game with Genex's existing hosting tools when the user asks for a draft or public release.
